_comment: PLAN-B: the net-site helper calls each recorded fixture turn is expected to make, as { corpus_id: { turn_index: [netKind, ...] } }. A fixture or turn not listed expects none. runCorpus fails a fixture whose observed calls differ. Keystone ① (orphan/no-op net) and keystone ② (marker-② catch-all) each give the model one retry before their canned line.
